summary: Identical inputs aborted with 'script failed (syntax, exception, memory limit or execution deadline)' at varying ticks, and the same commands passed on a quiet, awake host. Every completed run is byte-identical. The aborts follow host suspension (system sleep while the Mac was locked) or CPU contention (a concurrent rustc build from another worktree). That is consistent with the 50 ms wall-clock script budget, not with the steering solver or a deterministic script error.
